purpose: Build and reproduce deterministic neutral microstructure features without testing direction, outcomes, execution, or PnL.

temporal_contract.eligibility_rule: A source row may affect only the bucket containing ts_recv and book as-of state for later buckets in the same market-state segment; ts_event is never used for availability.
temporal_contract.state_boundary_rule: Clear persisted MBP state and quote-OFI transition baseline at every segment start; never carry a book state or transition across segment boundaries.

input_fields.mbp10_book_fields: For each level 00 through 09 and each side bid and ask: px, sz, ct, in level-major then side-major then field-major canonical order.

mbp10_authoritative_state_policy.authority: Vendor MBP-10 is the sole authority for top-ten book-state features.
mbp10_authoritative_state_policy.bucket_close_state: The last MBP-10 row in frozen row order with ts_recv less than bucket_end_ns and in the same market-state segment.
mbp10_authoritative_state_policy.persistence: If a segment has an earlier MBP-10 row but none in the current bucket, persist that exact authoritative row as the bucket-close state.
mbp10_authoritative_state_policy.missing_state: If no MBP-10 row has occurred since the segment start, state_available is false and every nullable book-derived feature is null.
mbp10_authoritative_state_policy.snapshot_and_reset_state: The vendor row remains authoritative. Snapshot and reset rows are never reconstructed or replaced.
mbp10_authoritative_state_policy.two_sided_definition: Level-00 bid and ask prices are not undefined and their size and count values are positive.
mbp10_authoritative_state_policy.continuous_book_gate: When two-sided during CONTINUOUS_MATCHING, best ask must be greater than or equal to best bid. Locked books are reported; crossed books fail integrity.

quote_ofi.allocation: Assign a transition to the bucket containing the current MBP-10 row's ts_recv.
quote_ofi.eligible_transition: Previous and current rows are in the same segment, neither is a snapshot or reset, and both are two-sided.
quote_ofi.skipped_transition: Every current MBP-10 row that is not an eligible transition, including the first row in a segment, increments quote_ofi_skipped_count.

mbo_event_flow_policy.authority: MBO contributes only raw receive-time event-flow measurements; it never supplies a top-ten book state.
mbo_event_flow_policy.snapshot_exclusion: Snapshot rows contribute only to total and snapshot counts and never to live quantity or pressure features.

side_semantics.A: ask resting side or sell aggressor for action T
side_semantics.B: bid resting side or buy aggressor for action T

mbo_event_flow_policy.regular_add: Live action A with side A or B, positive size, defined price, and flag 64 not set.
mbo_event_flow_policy.top_of_book_add: Live action A with flag 64 set; count separately and exclude from add quantities and pressure ratios.
mbo_event_flow_policy.cancel: Live action C with side A or B and positive size; the row size is aggregated as cancelled quantity.
mbo_event_flow_policy.modify: Live action M with side A or B, positive size, and defined price; aggregate row size only as modify_new_size_qty and never reinterpret it as a size delta.
mbo_event_flow_policy.trade: Live action T with positive size; side B is buy-aggressor quantity, side A is sell-aggressor quantity, and side N is unknown-aggressor quantity.
mbo_event_flow_policy.fill: Live action F with positive size; keep bid, ask, and unknown resting-side quantities separate and never combine them with trade quantity.
mbo_event_flow_policy.reset: Action R increments reset count only and contributes no economic quantity.
mbo_event_flow_policy.none: Action N increments none count only and contributes no economic quantity.

mbp_price_features_fixed_1e9.best_bid_px_fixed_1e9: level-00 bid price when two-sided, else null
mbp_price_features_fixed_1e9.best_ask_px_fixed_1e9: level-00 ask price when two-sided, else null
mbp_price_features_fixed_1e9.microprice_fixed_1e9: round_half_away((best_ask*bid_sz_00+best_bid*ask_sz_00)/(bid_sz_00+ask_sz_00)) when two-sided and denominator positive, else null

depth_formulas.depth_lN: Sum authoritative sz for levels 00 through N-1 on the named side; null when state is unavailable.
depth_formulas.order_count_lN: Sum authoritative ct for levels 00 through N-1 on the named side; null when state is unavailable.
depth_formulas.ratio_null_rule: null when state is unavailable or denominator is zero

feature_registry.classification: Every output is OBSERVED or CALCULATED. No signal, target, label, expected direction, or inference is produced.

missing_data_policy.mbo_no_record_bucket: All event counts and quantities are zero; ratio features with zero denominator are null.
missing_data_policy.mbp_no_update_bucket_within_segment: Persist the most recent authoritative MBP-10 row from that segment and report its increasing book_age_ns.
missing_data_policy.mbp_no_state_since_segment_start: state_available false; state identifiers, age, prices, depths, counts, and derived book features null; booleans book_two_sided, book_locked, and book_crossed false.
missing_data_policy.malformed_levels: Count as an integrity violation; do not repair or substitute a level.
missing_data_policy.unknown_actions_or_sides: Count explicitly; never infer or repair.

implementation_independence.primary: Streaming fixed-length arrays indexed directly by integer bucket index; sequential MBP as-of state machine.
implementation_independence.reference: Streaming dictionary accumulators keyed by bucket start followed by an independently coded ordered-grid materialization; independent MBP segment state machine.
implementation_independence.complete_source_passes: Each implementation independently reads every MBO and every MBP-10 source row.
implementation_independence.comparison: Compare source input checksums, output row counts, null counts, per-column canonical checksums, complete-row checksum, technical diagnostics, and output parquet SHA-256.

verdict_rules.FAIL_PREDECESSOR_OR_SOURCE_INTEGRITY: Any required predecessor, source hash, source schema, source count, date, publisher, instrument, or completeness gate fails.
verdict_rules.FAIL_FEATURE_INTEGRITY: A single implementation violates allocation, timestamp, bucket-grid, segment-boundary, book-integrity, flag, action, or prohibited-work gates.
verdict_rules.FAIL_REPRODUCTION: Both implementations pass independently but differ on any frozen count, null count, checksum, diagnostic, or output payload hash.
verdict_rules.PASS: Every frozen integrity and reproduction gate passes exactly.

prohibited: modifying any predecessor verdict or sealed artifact
aligning MBO rows to MBP-10 rows or book boundaries
using book equality to choose or repair any event
inspecting future returns or directional outcomes
creating targets, labels, signals, candidates, or directional relationships
trades, PnL, R multiples, or account returns
human or model inspection of emitted market values
completion_policy: Apply the frozen gates once, preserve the honest result, document and seal Step 4A, and stop without correction or research.
